reference_compatibility.reason: Only coilEM's solved region changes: every request sets solve_params.symmetry to auto, so coilEM meshes and solves one repeating sector when the geometry and winding repeat around the circle, and the full motor otherwise. FEMM always solves the whole motor and never reads this field, so the frozen protocol 1.10.0 references remain valid for the changed requests. Motors, materials, currents, grids, iteration caps, floors and gates are unchanged. A sector solve reproduces the full-circle solve of the same mesh to round-off (tests/test_sector_symmetry.py); against a separately meshed full motor it differs at mesh level.
